title: introduce-episodic-prompt-snapshot-sweeper-and-gradual-holdback-hook
author: Maya Chen
description: Add an episodic prompt snapshot sweeper and a gradual holdback CI hook to reduce transient noise in prompt-set regression signals and provide a controlled soft-fail path for short-lived spikes. Motivation: recent regression alerts showed high sensitivity to ephemeral prompt bursts that later self-corrected; this change introduces time-windowed snapshotting, decay-weighted anchoring, and an automated holdback policy that escalates failures progressively instead of failing CI immediately. The implementation includes a new Sweeper hook that folds prompt snapshots into short-lived episodes, a Holdback controller that gates CI failures into soft-warnings for the first N minutes/hours and then promotes to hard-fail if persistent, and a small companion tool to backfill historical episodes for retrospective analysis. This PR contains code, tests, docs, CI integration, and a short migration plan for existing prompt sets.
